programme.title: Arena
programme.sub-title: Dylan Thomas: From Grave to Cradle
programme.desc: Nigel Williams' 2003 profile of Swansea-born poet Dylan Thomas, whose work, especially his most famous piece Under Milk Wood, has influenced cultural icons such as John Lennon and Bob Dylan. The film tries to find out whether the basic elements of his legend are false - including the 18 whiskies that supposedly killed him in 1953 - and asks if the lurid stories prevent readers from truly understanding his poetry

programme.title: Timeshift
programme.sub-title: Bridging the Gap: How the Severn Bridge Was Built
programme.desc: Liz Bonnin marks the 50th anniversary of the construction of the Severn Bridge in a Timeshift special telling the inside story of its design and construction. As the motorway link between England and Wales, the Severn Bridge was described as 'the most perfect suspension bridge in the world', and Liz reveals how its unique, slim-line structure came about by accident

programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.desc: Petroc Trelawny presents a concert from the Royal Albert Hall, which opens with Lahav Shani conducting the Munich Philharmonic in Louise Farrenc's dramatic Overture No 2. Pianist Argerich then joins the orchestra for Beethoven's Second Piano Concerto, before the programme concludes with Brahms' warm and joyful Brahms' Fourth Symphony

programme.title: Shelagh Delaney's Salford - Monitor
programme.desc: Ken Russell's portrait of Shelagh Delaney, originally broadcast in 1960, two months before her 21st birthday. The film provides an insight into the writer's native Salford, following her through bustling markets and past pubs, factories and terraced houses that were a key factor in the unique sense of community that informed her work. Introduced by Huw Wheldon

programme.title: Peter Egan Remembers - A Taste of Honey
programme.desc: The actor reflects on the 1984 adaptation of Shelagh Delaney's play, discussing the background to the drama and why it remains so powerful and still has such relevance today

programme.title: A Taste of Honey
programme.desc: A girl gets pregnant by a sailor and finds comfort with a gay friend. Michael Simpsons 1984 adaptation of Shelagh Delaney's play, starring Jane Freeman, Ian Targett, Peter Egan and Tony Armatrading

programme.title: Sian Phillips Remembers - Under Milk Wood
programme.desc: The actress looks back on Dylan Thomas's Under Milk Wood and her own experiences with various adaptations that have brought the poet's 'play for voices' to cinema and TV audiences. She recalls the BBC's 2014 version that brought together a huge range of Welsh talent including Tom Jones, Matthew Rhys, Charlotte Church, Michael Sheen and Katherine Jenkins. She also looks further back, sharing the story of her encounters with Dylan Thomas, and her part in the 1972 film, which saw her working alongside her then-husband Peter O'Toole, Richard Burton, his wife Elizabeth Taylor

programme.title: Under Milk Wood
programme.desc: Star-studded performance of Dylan Thomas's radio play from locations across New York, Los Angeles, London, Cardiff and Laugharne. Michael Sheen opens as First Voice, with Tom Jones as Captain Cat, and as each of Dylan's characters joins in, the piece builds into a collage of famous voices and faces. They include Matthew Rhys, Ioan Gruffudd, Sian Phillips, Jonathan Pryce, Bryn Terfel, Katherine Jenkins, Griff Rhys Jones, Charlotte Church, Robert Pugh, Eve Myles, Owen Teale and Kimberley Nixon. The words are intercut with evocative imagery inspired by the play, while the performance was created as part of a live event by National Theatre Wales

programme.title: Nature and Us: A History Through Art
programme.desc: James Fox uses art to explore how humans began to try to understand nature for the very first time. From the Song dynasty in China and the Islamic world, through to the Scientific Revolution and the advent of the industrial era, he shows the very different ways in which humans came to both appreciate and understand nature

programme.title: The Goldbergs

Can the chef break Tom's iron grip on the business and persuade him to change his outdated approach?

programme.title: Lego Masters Australia
programme.desc: In a challenging eight-hour build, each of the ten teams chooses an empty toy package from a Kmart store and must invent a toy that matches the box's theme, from Karen Doll to Dino Digger and Galaxy Gallivanter. programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

Can the chef save the business and mend the warring family's frayed relationships?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: Home (2015)

programme.title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992)

Comedy sequel, starring Macaulay Culkin, Joe Pesci, Daniel Stern, Brenda Fricker and Tim Curry

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Blood-curdling tales from America's favourite family in another Halloween special. The spooky stories feature an island inhabited by 'manimals', plus tales about an army of Homer clones and zombie cowboys

programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Slept Too Little

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.sub-title: The Last of the Red Hat Mamas

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge captures a fleeing con artist and suddenly becomes so enthusiastic about law enforcement that she decides to join the Springfield Police Academy - but Homer has reservations about his wife being a cop

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog (2020)

Scientific genius Dr Robotnik is hired to investigate, and becomes obsessed with capturing the creature for his power. Live-action fantasy adventure based on the video games, starring James Marsden and Jim Carrey, with the voice of Ben Schwartz

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.sub-title: How I Spent My Strummer Vacation
programme.desc: Homer is asked to help the Rolling Stones with a forthcoming benefit gig, filling his head with dreams of rock 'n' roll stardom. Unfortunately, they only want him to stand in as a roadie. Featuring the voices of Mick Jagger, Keith Richards, Lenny Kravitz, Tom Petty and Elvis Costello

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.sub-title: Bart v Lisa v the Third Grade
programme.desc: Lisa is thrilled to learn she has been moved up a grade at school - until she discovers Bart's poor performance has caused him to be demoted to the same class. Tensions inevitably develop between the pair, but a crisis during a field trip teaches them the value of working together. With the guest voice of Tony Bennett

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge has plastic surgery in an effort to lose weight, but a mix-up results in her being given breast implants instead - much to Homer's delight. With the guest voices of Adam West and Burt Ward, stars of 1960s TV series Batman

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: On an eventful tour of Italy in Mr Burns' new car, Homer, Marge and the kids encounter Sideshow Bob (guest star Kelsey Grammer), who begs them not to reveal his criminal past. Unfortunately for him, Lisa lets the cat out of the bag

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The body of a long-lost postman is found in a tree, with a mailbag containing a 40-year-old letter for Grandma Simpson. It reveals she had an affair around the time of Homer's conception, causing him to doubt whether Grampa is really his biological father. With the voices of Michael York, Joe Frazier and William H Macy

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay continues his travels across America saving failing restaurants from disaster. In the first of two visits to Mill Street Bistro in Norwalk, Ohio, the chef encounters Joe Nagy, who claims he has the best menu from New York to Los Angeles. However, his servers and diners tell a different story, and his resistance to change leads to some explosive confrontations

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: In the concluding part of his trip to the Mill Street Bistro in Norwalk, Ohio, Gordon's disagreement with proprietor Joe Nagy erupts into one of his most intense confrontations yet. Just when it looks like he has turned the corner and is ready to accept help, Joe slips back into his old ways, denying his own failings and picking petty fights. Can Gordon get this stubborn owner to finally accept his advice and secure the future of his restaurant?

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.sub-title: We're on the Road to D'ohwhere
programme.desc: Homer is forced to drive Bart to a discipline camp in another state, meaning he has to miss out on a trip to Las Vegas with Moe and the gang. While they are away, Marge decides to hold a yard sale - but ends up getting arrested as a suspected drug dealer

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Groundskeeper Willie is made homeless and forced to move in with the family, giving Lisa the idea of trying to transform him into a gentleman. Meanwhile, Homer embarks on a campaign to save the company that manufactures his favourite blue trousers

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: Home Alone 3 (1997)
programme.desc: Cheeky eight-year-old Alex Pruitt is delighted to be given a remote-controlled toy car by his neighbour - unaware it contains a stolen microchip. A gang of crooks heads to Alex's town with the intention of recovering the valuable item, but the resourceful youngster has prepared for their arrival with a series of nasty booby-traps. Comedy sequel, starring Alex D Linz, Olek Krupa, Rya Kihlstedt and Lenny von Dohlen

programme.title: Lego Masters Australia
programme.desc: In the first elimination challenge of the series, the teams choose an item or group of items from a Chinese restaurant - from lobsters to a lucky cat, and from a vase to a giant pillar - and then have nine hours to create an exact replica out of Lego. The builds are scored out of 20, and teams will earn an extra three points if special guest Sophie Monk doesn't spot their recreated item within 90 seconds. Those bonus points soon become crucial, as the teams are vying for the Magic Brick, which grants them immunity from this elimination and the next

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: In Ohio, drama erupts as Gordon Ramsay tries to help a classic American diner that's in deep trouble. The owner Gus's vulgar behaviour is driving away staff and customers alike, and what Gordon discovers in the kitchen forces him to halt cooking and shut down the restaurant

programme.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
programme.desc: Memorable moments of 2021, featuring some of the country's favourite celebrities critiquing TV shows that they have watched. The prime suspects are her fellow quiz team-mates, who won their lucky windfall as part of a syndicate, and while some have put their money to good use, the victim's boyfriend has fallen on hard times and the media remain convinced he is the key to her murder. As allegations of affairs, fights and betrayal begin to surface, the team is left to ponder whether money really is the root of all evil

programme.title: New Tricks
programme.desc: The penultimate episode sees the retired detectives investigating possibly their most difficult cold case yet. A bloodstained bust is uncovered during construction work in a cemetery and the evidence points to the murder of an alternative-medicine practitioner seven years earlier. Further clues lead to the controversial world of cryopreservation - the practice of keeping clinically dead patients frozen to extend their life cycle. Sasha is determined they don't put a foot wrong - but with the sobering possibility that two perpetrators are still at large, the detectives are forced to go out on a limb

programme.title: New Tricks
